summary: Repair identity rename replication, replay and API compatibility regressions

replay.detail: Canonicalize rename request JSON before hashing so replicated canonical serialization preserves admission. Rebuild identity projections and historical name reservations during checkpoint replay. Include naming tables in canonical projection audits.

schema.detail: Native client rename methods decode the st3.v1 value envelope. Frozen client-v0 agent rows retain immutable storage IDs and their existing response schema, while detail lookups accept aliases.

rules.detail: Reference readers accept historical storage keys without applying the current declaration grammar. Declaration previews and reconcile work reads normalize aliases before subject-token and work selection. Batched desired and mission readers resolve aliases within their SQL queries.

compatibility.detail: No additional peer compatibility change beyond the identity-rename schema fence.

manual.detail: No additional manual migration is required.

recovery.detail: Projection replay reconstructs naming tables from retained durable facts rather than retaining stale naming rows.
